extracted.name: Cranberry spritz
extracted.description: Mix cranberry juice, orange juice and sparkling white grape juice to make this easy, non-alcoholic spritz. It's a perfect for a booze-free Christmas drink
instruction_lines: Pour 50ml cranberry juice into two champagne coups or wine glasses. Divide the orange juice between them, then stir.
Add 3 sage leaves and an ice cube or two to each glass, then top up with the sparkling grape juice.
